title: LangGraph orchestration
snippet: LangGraph models workflow and orchestration as a graph with explicit state. Checkpointing enables persistence, replay and human-in-the-loop approval. It provides fine-grained control but requires developers to design state transitions and failure recovery. It can support multi-agent applications.

title: CrewAI teams and flows
snippet: CrewAI supports role-based multi-agent teams and task delegation. Flows provide workflow control and orchestration. Compared with explicit graph state management, role abstractions can accelerate prototypes but require careful control of tools, cost and coordination.

title: AutoGen conversation agents
snippet: AutoGen supports multi-agent conversation, asynchronous messages and tool use. Its event-driven architecture helps agents collaborate. Teams require explicit termination criteria and evaluation to control latency and cost.

title: Building agents with tools
snippet: A tool-using agent combines a cloud model, tools and orchestration. Structured output and JSON schemas constrain tool arguments. Prompt injection is a risk when external pages contain instructions. Apply least privilege, validation and human approval for consequential actions; API keys must be protected.

title: Agent evaluation and tracing
snippet: Evaluation uses a fixed dataset, expected outputs and measurable criteria. Track accuracy, completeness, citation quality, latency, token usage and cost. Trace each tool call and failure. An LLM Judge is optional and has bias; deterministic metrics and human review remain necessary.

title: Retrieval augmented generation
snippet: RAG combines retrieval with generation. Embedding and vector search retrieve candidate passages; reranking can improve relevance. Chunking, metadata and citations affect answer quality. Compare retrieval recall, groundedness and latency with a fixed dataset.

title: SQLite storage
snippet: SQLite is an embedded transactional database suitable for single-user applications. It stores runs, traces and metrics in a local file. Concurrent writers are limited; short transactions and bounded data sizes help keep a lightweight app responsive.

title: AI Agent internship skills
snippet: An AI Agent project portfolio can demonstrate Python, API integration, orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability. Engineering skills include structured output, testing, debugging, prompt design and secure handling of API credentials. This fixture is a teaching example, not an actual hiring advertisement.

title: Reliable HTTP collection
snippet: HTTP clients require timeouts and bounded downloads. Retry policies should distinguish transient errors from invalid credentials. Cache repeated URL content, deduplicate sources and fall back to search snippets when fetching fails. Record failure reasons and avoid silently replacing live search with Mock results.

title: Streamlit application state
snippet: Streamlit session state retains UI results between reruns. A lightweight dashboard can show research reports, trace timelines and evaluation metrics. Single-process execution with SQLite avoids queues and services. Prevent duplicate submissions while a synchronous workflow runs.
